title: Annual Trends in Gavi-Funded Vaccine Introductions
text:
Figure 1: Cumulative Introduction of Gavi-Funded Vaccines by Year





The effectiveness of foreign aid can be measured by how many lives it saves and how many children it vaccinates. This plot uses vaccine introduction data from Gavi to show how many countries adopted each vaccine between Pre-2003 and 2019. The dataset includes launch years and vaccine names, and has been cleaned to remove duplicates and standardize entries. The visualization groups introductions by year to track progress over time and shows how Gavi-supported vaccines were scaled across low-income countries. The plot highlights that vaccine uptake accelerated after 2003, especially for Pentavalent, Pneumococcal, and Rotavirus, reflecting the growing impact of global vaccine aid.

title: Data Sources
text:
Data Sources
The data for this project comes from a single source:

Gavi Vaccine Introduction Dates: A CSV file listing the year each Gavi-supported vaccine was introduced by country and vaccine type, obtained from Gavi’s publicly available data.

The data was cleaned by standardizing vaccine names, removing duplicates, filtering for introduced vaccines, and converting launch dates into year values for analysis and visualization.
